what: The pinned reference timed against itself on the dev partition in the real warm Docker sandbox (cgroup v1 host), 5 interleaved samples
reading: A true speedup of 1.0 measures 0.96-1.06 as a 5-sample median, with single ratios 0.79-1.10 (about +/-20%). The >= 1.10x geomean gate therefore needs its sample count from V1-07's power analysis; 5 samples cannot resolve it.
